title: Speech does not remove model and tool latency
environment: Guided capture orchestration. Offline timing success is not live human-motion acceptance, and no automatic retry of user effort is implied.
goal: Collect baseline, held-state and return windows inside a bounded observation period.
approach: Historical failed assumption: Changing communication modality or passing a manually driven terminal control was assumed to validate the real guidance path.
what_worked: Historical correction: Move stage progression into a local state-aware wrapper under existing supervision/deadlines. Test the same wrapper with synthetic SDK and speech before requesting more user effort. Verification reported by the source: Recorded local synthetic runs collected 60/20/20. Delayed, failed and hanging speech, lifecycle hangs, stop and cleanup cases passed; actual audibility and physical mapping remained unverified.
what_failed: Historical observed failure: A chat-paced attempt collected 60/0/0 samples; a spoken-countdown retry still ended at 60/20/0 without the return window.
why: Confirmed: time-critical progression still depended on model/tool round trips. A later acknowledgment could not reconstruct uncaptured data.
improved_method: Keep model/tool round trips outside bounded real-time control. Test the exact execution path, distinguishing user confirmation from scheduled stage boundaries.
when_to_use: Guided capture orchestration. Offline timing success is not live human-motion acceptance, and no automatic retry of user effort is implied.
when_not_to_use: Offline timing success is not live human-motion acceptance, and no automatic retry of user effort is implied.
known_limitations: This is an independently curated generalization of an earlier recorded failure. No source-side experiment was rerun during this registration; observation_date is the 2026-10-09 knowledge-review date, not the incident date. Applicability and root-cause claims remain limited to the source-reported conditions.
